verbs.description: Each node of the swarm that reports to this roster: its role, portal link and when it last reported; its live sessions, each with its claude.ai link and task id; its count of sessions in the last 7 days; its services with whether each is up; and the tools it can use, each with when it was last checked and last used.

Take a batch of facts from one node's telemetry-node part: a hello with its whole state, or session, service, usage and tool changes. Answers resync true when the roster needs a hello first. Only that node may report for itself.

params.name: swarm
params.description: The swarm the node opted in to, from its install config's [telemetry] swarm.

params.name: items
params.description: The facts, each {type: hello | session | service | usage | tools, ...}.

verbs.description: Every seat on social's roster, as social last reported it: its state, node, Remote Control switch and claude.ai link.

Each singleton service of the edge list, with its host node, its health there (up, down, or unknown while the host has not reported it), when its host last answered a call to it, and when any node last used it.
